sentences.text: 1 By the instant petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner is seeking quashment of FIR registered against him vide FIR No.0128/2023 on 05.04.2023 at Police Station Raisen, for the offence under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code; Sections 22 and 23 of the Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019 and Section 6(1) of the Madhya Pradesh Protection of Interest of Depositors Act, 2000.

entities.text: Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Madhya Pradesh Protection of Interest of Depositors Act, 2000
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner is seeking quashment of FIR mainly on the ground that the complainant has given an affidavit before the Superintendent of Police saying that he lodged the FIR against the petitioner under the pressure created upon him by the police authorities.
He submits that the complainant has also stated in his affidavit that he does not want to prosecute the matter against the petitioner and in fact, he has no grievance with the petitioner.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the petitioner and on perusal of documents available on record, I am of the opinion that at this stage, this Court cannot test the reliability of the affidavit filed by the complainant nor it can be ascertained that he was under the pressure of petitioner or of police authorities.

Under such circumstances, the Superintendent of Police is the competent authority to look into the matter and make an enquiry to ascertain whether the FIR has been rightly registered against the petitioner or not.

However, if the said authority comes to a conclusion that the complainant under the pressure of police authorities had filed a fictitious FIR, then remedy to file a closure report or any other alternative remedy available to him can be adopted by the authority in accordance with law.
The matter is purely under the prerogative of Superintendent of Police, Raisen for deciding the controversy as has been raised in this petition.
It is also expected from the Superintendent of Police for expediting the matter because it ultimately makes a dent in the image of the petitioner.
With the aforesaid observation, this petition is disposed of.
SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE Devashish DEVASHISH MISHRA 2023.06.22 10:33:40 +05'30'
